title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: Remember that in the context of SVD, the columns of the matrix U are orthogonal to each other. What does it mean for two vectors to be orthogonal?

title: Checking Orthogonality
text: To check if two vectors are orthogonal, you can calculate their dot product. If the dot product is zero, the vectors are orthogonal. Try calculating the dot product of $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$.

title: Understanding Validity
text: In the context of SVD, a valid combination of $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ should maintain orthogonality. If the dot product is zero, the combination is valid. What did you find from your calculation?
